narrative.overview: Event is an editorial network around real-world events. Warm paper, charcoal ink, muted terracotta actions and ticket inspired date marks separate it from a generic social feed.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, reduced-glare surfaces in both themes.
Event listings use organizer supplied media and a clear date stamp.
Salon posts read as notes attached to an event, not floating timeline cards.
Product details and states come from application data.
Layouts adapt from narrow phones to desktop without horizontal scrolling; mobile navigation stays reachable and opaque.

rules.name: Event before timeline
rules.body: Keep the event, its date and venue visible as context for the people and conversation connected to it.

dos: Use real published event information and organizer supplied imagery.
Pair semantic colors with readable status text.
Keep discovery, booking and event conversations easy to reach.
donts: Do not use purple gradients or pill shaped buttons.
Do not add emoji icons, AI generated photos, fake testimonials or invented metrics.
Do not use glass effects, floating card stacks or vague promotional claims.
